limitations: These observations measure archive storage and filesystem free space, not typical feature development peak RSS, build target disk, CI cost or feedback latency.
The increase in reported free space cannot be attributed solely to task compression: root temporary-file cleanup and other filesystem activity were not isolated.
The collector's final per-file compression ledger will provide richer provenance and final archive totals.
The 500 MB hard evidence budget and restrictions on full clones, local Rust builds and cleanup of existing user caches remain in force.

finalStorageObservation.method: Read-only regular-file stat sizes/allocation, git rev-list objects relative to base plus git cat-file objectsize/objectsize:disk, git count-objects, du -sk common git directory, statvfs/df. No archive copies or build execution.
